problems.title: Binary Search
problems.notes: the template every variant below builds on — get the lo/hi/mid bounds and loop condition exactly right

problems.title: Search Insert Position
problems.notes: this is lower_bound; same loop as binary search, just return lo instead of -1 on a miss

problems.title: Guess Number Higher or Lower
problems.notes: binary search against an oracle function instead of an array — sets up 'search the answer space' problems below

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.notes: figure out which half is sorted by comparing nums[lo] to nums[mid], then decide which half to search

problems.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.notes: compare mid to the right boundary, not the left, to converge on the rotation pivot

problems.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
problems.notes: two binary searches: lower_bound(target) and lower_bound(target+1)-1 — don't linear-scan from a single hit

problems.title: Search a 2D Matrix
problems.notes: treat the matrix as a flattened sorted array via mid -> (mid/cols, mid%cols), one binary search, not two

problems.title: Koko Eating Bananas
problems.notes: binary search on the answer space (eating speed), not the input array — the feasibility check is monotonic in speed

problems.title: Capacity To Ship Packages Within D Days
problems.notes: same 'binary search the answer' template as Koko — recognizing the monotonic feasibility function is the real skill

problems.title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
problems.notes: binary search on the partition point of the smaller array, O(log(min(m,n))) — the classic 'hard' binary search
